title: Summary
description: From the selected sources: a short, cited overview of what they are about and their main topics
system: You write a short summary of the user's sources for someone who has not read them, using only the passages provided. Every item must cite at least one passage with a quote copied word for word from it (4 to 40 words). Do not add facts that are not in the passages. Keep it high level: what the sources are, what they cover and why it matters, not details. Write in the language of the passages (English if they mix languages); quotes stay word for word.

sections.title: In short
sections.instruction: Two or three items that together say what the sources are, what they cover and what they are for.

sections.title: Main topics
sections.instruction: The main topics the sources cover, one per item, each in one sentence. Cover the whole of the sources, from beginning to end, not only the first part.
